cases.question: What is Hurtigruten's overall target year for being emission-free?
cases.expected_answer: Hurtigruten has set an overall target of being emission-free in 2050, governed by its Board and Executive Management Team.
cases.expected_text: We have set an overall target of being emissionfree in 2050 that is governed by our Board and Executive Management Team.
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 7 of hurtigruten-esg-report-2021.pdf. Page 21 also names 2040 as the carbon neutral Scope 1 milestone; this case asks only about the overall 2050 target.

cases.question: By what year does GSK aim to have a net zero impact on climate across its full value chain?
cases.expected_answer: GSK's goal is a net zero impact on climate across its full value chain by 2030.
cases.expected_text: Our goal is to have net zero impact on climate across our full value chain by 2030.
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 16 of esg-performance-report-2021.pdf.

cases.question: What share of its 2020 footprint does GSK aim to offset with carbon removal solutions?
cases.expected_answer: GSK aims to offset around 20% of its 2020 footprint using responsible and high-quality carbon removal solutions.
cases.expected_text: GSK aims to offset around 20% of our 2020 footprint using responsible and high-quality carbon removal solutions.
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 32 of esg-performance-report-2021.pdf.

cases.question: Which reporting period does the JM sustainability report cover?
cases.expected_answer: The JM report covers the reporting period of January 1, 2018 through December 31, 2020.
cases.expected_text: The content of this publication reflects information and metrics gathered during the reporting period of January 1, 2018 through December 31, 2020.
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 20 of jm-sustainability-report-2021.pdf.

cases.question: Which ISO certifications is Hurtigruten working towards?
cases.expected_answer: Hurtigruten is certifying the company in accordance with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001.
cases.expected_text: We are certifying the company in accordance with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001. We invest in green technology
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 28 of hurtigruten-esg-report-2021.pdf.

cases.question: How much did GSK reduce its overall water use in 2021 compared to 2020?
cases.expected_answer: In 2021 GSK reduced overall water use in its operations by 16% compared to 2020, and by 21% at sites in high water stress regions.
cases.expected_text: In 2021, we reduced overall water use in our operations by 16% compared to 2020 and by 21% in sites in high water stress regions.
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 16 of esg-performance-report-2021.pdf.

cases.question: What CO2 emission reduction did the biomass boiler at the SWM Le Mans site support, and over what period?
cases.expected_answer: The Le Mans, France biomass boiler supported a 20% CO2 emission reduction over a four-year period after its capital investment and installation.
cases.expected_text: Our Le Mans, France site uses a biomass boiler on site, and it supported a 20% CO2 emission reduction on a four-year period after its capital investment and installation.
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 20 of swm-esg-report-2022.pdf.

cases.question: Which North American mid-stream company issued a $1 billion note integrating ESG targets into its loan terms in July 2021?
cases.expected_answer: Enbridge became the latest North American mid-stream company to join the group, with a $1 billion note integrating ESG targets into its loan terms.
cases.expected_text: In July 2021, Enbridge became the latest North American mid-stream company to join the group, with a $1 billion note that integrates ESG targets into its loan terms.
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 9 of cwf-cecn-esg-report-2021.pdf. The report covers sustainability-linked loans in the Canadian energy sector.

cases.question: What share of GSK's palm oil volume was traced back to mill level?
cases.expected_answer: Through its membership of Action on Sustainable Derivatives, GSK traced 88% of palm oil volume back to mill level.
cases.expected_text: Our membership of Action on Sustainable Derivatives helped us trace 88% of palm oil volume back to mill level.
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 18 of esg-performance-report-2021.pdf.

cases.question: By what year does Hurtigruten want its first zero emission ship sailing on the Norwegian coast?
cases.expected_answer: Hurtigruten targets its first zero emission ship sailing on the Norwegian coast by 2030.
cases.expected_text: Carbon neutral Scope 1 operations by 2040. First zero emission ship sailing on the Norwegian coast by 2030.
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 7 of hurtigruten-esg-report-2021.pdf.

cases.question: What did joining the Net-Zero Banking Alliance commit the bank to?
cases.expected_answer: By joining the Net-Zero Banking Alliance the bank undertook to align its activities with scientific scenarios consistent with reaching the Paris Climate Agreement's objectives.
cases.expected_text: By joining the Net-Zero Banking Alliance, the Bank undertook to align its activities with scientific scenarios consistent with reaching the Paris Climate Agreement
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 35 of integrated-report-2021-2022.pdf; quote stops before the Agreement's objectives to avoid a unicode apostrophe in the extraction.

cases.question: What share of the waste produced on its ships and on land does Hurtigruten aim to reuse and recycle, and by when?
cases.expected_answer: By 2030 Hurtigruten wants to reuse and recycle 100% of the waste it produces on its ships and on land.
cases.expected_text: By 2030 we want to reuse and recycle 100% of the waste we produce on our ships and on land.
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 9 of hurtigruten-esg-report-2021.pdf.

cases.question: What share of scrap produced at the SWM Roanoke, Virginia plant is sold or re-used instead of landfilled?
cases.expected_answer: SWM reduces landfilled waste at its Roanoke, Virginia plant by selling or re-using over 95% of the scrap produced there.
cases.expected_text: We reduce landfilled waste at our Roanoke, Virginia plant by either selling or re-using over 95% of scrap that is produced at Roanoke.
cases.notes: Verified verbatim on page 21 of swm-esg-report-2022.pdf.
